post.caption:
37 tasks on your list. Allah only asked you for 5. 🤍

“Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.” (2:286)

The list will always be long. Put the prayer first, and carry the rest with Him. This morning: put Dhuhr at the top of today's list. 🤲

captions: 11:47 p.m. The office is empty. Coffee cold since six.
Dhuhr: “after this email.” Asr: “after this call.”
Maghrib: you didn't even hear it.
Then the laptop dies. Black screen. Silence.
6:40 a.m. Your kitchen. The kettle hums.
On a new list, you write one word first: Fajr.
You pray. The 37 tasks are still there.
But now, you carry them with Him.
